layout.object_file: [JSR $0803][17-byte header][code][constant pool][routines]; local variables follow in memory

header.+13: LOCBEG1 -> $7B (= last byte of object file)
header.+19: FLAG -> $16: $00 define COMMON; $FF COMMON must match $69-$6E (else error $A3)
header.status: confirmed by RUNTIME init code at $0875-$08A2

implicit_end.note: always appended after the last line

layout.line_start: a line with no code shares the next line's address
layout.routine_order: numeric variables (symbol order), constants (pool order), string variables; arrays: see allocation
layout.constant_pool: one entry per distinct (value,type); order = 32-bucket hash, bucket = low byte & 31 (int, stored big-endian) or exponent & 31 (real); insertion order within a bucket

allocation.rule: temps first; then numeric scalars, numeric arrays, string scalars, string arrays; each group in symbol order
allocation.symbol_order: bucket h = (3*(c1-1) + c2 + T) mod 32, 5-bit chars (A=1,'0'=16, c2=0 if one letter), T real 0 / string 1 / int 2; buckets ascending, insertion (source) order within
allocation.sizes: real 5, int 2, string 2 (pointer); arrays: product(max+1) * size, no header
allocation.temps: expression temporaries occupy the first slots of locals; reused across statements; count = max depth
open: array group order vs symbol order not separately tested
FN parameter slot (comes first, not by hash)

peephole.rule: store to V immediately followed (same line) by a load of V: the load is omitted (also IF V right after the store tests flags)

numeric.bytes: (A2 op AD)* A2 op A0 hi A9 lo 4C disp
numeric.note: AD/2C swallow the next LDX; one entry per op used, highest op first

array.bytes: 38 A9 18 20 disp [addr lo hi][ndims][max index lo hi]*ndims

ops_int.6..13: real ops 0..7 applied to the int variable (6 load as real, 7 store FAC rounded, 8 add, 9 sub, 10 mul, 11 cmp, 12 ARG, 13 div)

commutative.note: if left is complex and right simple

compare.result: real 0/1 in FAC, Z flag set for IF

emit_real_left: JSR RT.AND|RT.OR (if right real) / RT.AND/I|RT.OR/I (if right int)
and_or.note: left simple variable tested in memory

types.int_arith_on: int op int (+ - *, negate) done in IACC; JSR RT.FLOAT.IACC if a real is needed
types.int_arith_off: int operands floated via op6/op8.. ; store to int via op7
types.compare_int: int compare (op5 on int routines) regardless of the int arithmetic option

constants.int_const_on: integer literal is int where the context can use an int (int op with int arith on, int store, int-entry statement, int compare); a lone literal stored to a real is a real constant

V=E: V.op1 (or op7 for int target of real E)
statements.PRINT: items in order: string -> RT.PRINTSTR, real -> RT.PRINTNUM, int -> RT.PRINTINT, ',' -> RT.COMMA, TAB( -> E, RT.TAB, SPC( -> E, RT.SPC; ';' nothing; JSR CRDO unless the statement ends with ; , TAB( or SPC(
statements.DEF FN F(P)=E / FN F(A): in place: JMP past body; body = P.op1, E, RTS. call: E(A), JSR body

emit: JSR entry (int entry when E is int: VTAB, COLOR, ...)

load: subscript(s) as int: int const / E then AYINT; extra subscripts pushed with RT.PUSH.SUBSCRIPT
arrays.default_dims: 10 per subscript without DIM; DIM generates no code

resume_debug.emit: JSR $1423 before each statement that can error (assignments, PRINT, IF, FOR, NEXT, INPUT, VTAB, ...); not before HOME, END, GOTO, GOSUB, RETURN, REM, DATA

rem_bang.recognition: REM followed by '!' (spaces allowed) and INTEGER/DEFCOMMON/USECOMMON/CLEAR COMMON/CLEAR CHAIN; screen prints RECOGNIZED
rem_bang.INTEGER: names become int (2 bytes, int dispatcher) but keep the real-name hash bucket (T=0)
rem_bang.DEFCOMMON/USECOMMON: COMMON block at program start: numeric then string sub-block, declaration order; routines still in hash order; USECOMMON -> header flag $FF

memory.library L: object starts JSR L; all RUNTIME calls relocated by L-$0803; default program start L+4013
memory.program: load address; COMBEG1 = start-1 (COMMON at program start, object after it)
memory.variables: LOCBEG1 = variables start - 1 (default: end of object file)
memory.code: symbolic code identical for all layouts

allocation_specials.order: [temps][DEF FN parameters, definition order][named numerics by hash]...; string temps lead the string section
allocation_specials.fn_param: separate symbol from a global of the same name

literals.integer: decided by value: 5.0, 1E2, 007 are integers; .5 real; -0 = int 0 + negate

expressions_more.and_or: the simple operand (either side) is tested in memory; the other is evaluated into FAC
